name: hermes-agent
description: The agent that grows with you
one_liner: A personal AI assistant you can run on a cheap server that lives in apps like Telegram or Slack, remembers your past conversations, and teaches itself new tricks as it works with you.
buyer: A solo consultant or small-business owner who wants a personal AI assistant reachable from their phone via chat apps, without paying per-seat SaaS pricing or being locked to one AI provider.
business_use_cases: A freelance consultant runs it on a $5 VPS and talks to it over Telegram to triage client emails and schedule follow-ups while away from their laptop.
A small e-commerce owner sets up scheduled automations (daily sales report, nightly backup check) delivered straight to a Discord channel, replacing a part-time VA task.
An agency builds client-specific bots on top of it, each with its own memory and skills, and resells access as a lightweight AI-assistant product.

money_ideas.idea: Sell managed hosting so non-technical buyers don't have to run their own VPS or set up integrations themselves.
Offer a 'done-for-you' setup service that configures the agent, its skills, and its chat-platform connections for a small business.

steal_this: Spin up a hosted 'personal AI assistant in a weekend' offer: you configure Hermes on a cheap VM with Telegram + calendar + email skills for a flat setup fee, then charge a small monthly fee for hosting and updates.
